_README: Epic key -> display title + one-line story. Hand-maintained; the ONLY hand-maintained input to docs/epic-board.md. A manager minting a new epic adds its line here in the same turn. An epic with no entry still renders — it just shows a de-slugged key and no story, which is the visible nudge to write one.

epic:cj-flow-v2-ship.title: Ship CJ Flow v2
epic:cj-flow-v2-ship.story: Build v2, measure it honestly against v1 on a server we can trust, and let a go/no-go gate decide whether it ships.

epic:secrets-on-public-tip.title: Secrets on the public tip
epic:secrets-on-public-tip.story: Credentials are sitting in a public repo. Find what leaked, rotate it, then make a repeat impossible.

epic:router-single-source.title: One registry decides what commands exist
epic:router-single-source.story: Generate the router prompt and the training corpus from the registry, then retrain — so the lists agree by construction instead of by care.

epic:seal-the-test-tier.title: Seal the test tier
epic:seal-the-test-tier.story: "Unit" tests reach the network and spend real inference, and the coverage frame cannot see 40k lines — so a green run does not mean what it says.

epic:seat-and-repo-resolution.title: Seat and repo resolution
epic:seat-and-repo-resolution.story: Something scoped to a seat or a repo keeps getting resolved from a global default instead. One design mistake, filed three times by three people.

epic:answers-without-their-basis.title: Answers without their basis
epic:answers-without-their-basis.story: A tool answers and does not say what it filtered out or what it objected to, so the reader cannot tell a real result from a narrow one.

epic:authz-and-sandboxing.title: Authz and sandboxing
epic:authz-and-sandboxing.story: Any authenticated account can cause arbitrary execution on the box — an endpoint with no role check, and generated code that runs unsandboxed.

epic:image-gen-on-proper-auth.title: Image generation on proper auth
epic:image-gen-on-proper-auth.story: The ruling is project-id plus ADC, never an API key — and it cannot be honoured for images until Imagen is enabled on the project.

epic:expeditor-arg-extraction.title: Expeditor argument extraction
epic:expeditor-arg-extraction.story: Podcast-generator was conceived as "make a podcast from a topic" and implemented as a file reader; the training half and the fencing half both follow from that.

epic:weil-deep-research.title: Weil parallel research engine
epic:weil-deep-research.story: The 9-stage parallel deep-research engine in weil-parallel-search. Plan approved, waiting on the word to start.

epic:skills-distillation.title: Skills distillation
epic:skills-distillation.story: Grading the distilled agent — including a dimension that has never actually been judged on either surface.

epic:unassigned.title: Unassigned
epic:unassigned.story: Deliberately belongs to no epic. A fake story is worse than a labelled gap, so these stay honest rather than tidy.

epic:manager-roster-single-source.title: One source for who is a manager
epic:manager-roster-single-source.story: Two environment-variable families both answer "who is a manager", they feed different consumers, and nothing compared them — so they drifted silently until Rick read a retired name off a status card.

epic:board-visibility.title: Rick can see his own board
epic:board-visibility.story: The task store held every fact Rick needed and surfaced none of them where he actually looks — so the board gets a fixed URL, a link from the Lupin Dev Tools page, and a generated-at stamp in his own timezone rather than UTC.
